access_boundary: This record represents the July 2024 Mistral Nemo 12B (24.07) release across its base and instruct weight repositories at commits a4477a2f977929a969745b69bbd62e03043551a5 and 04d8a90549d23fc6bd7f642064003592df51e9b3 (both last modified 2025-07-28), together with the open-mistral-nemo-2407 API model and its NIM container. The FP8 quantization, NVIDIA's NeMo-format repackaging, and later Ministral lines remain separate boundaries.
strengths: Ungated 12B base and instruct checkpoints under a four-surface declared Apache-2.0 grant
First-party API plus exact-model NVIDIA NIM hosting with a 128K context window
tradeoffs: No LICENSE file ships beside the weights; the grant rests on announcement, card, docs, and host declarations
The managed API is deprecated and retired with migration directed at Ministral 3 8B
